description: This file defines API routes for managing itinerary items in a travel planning backend. It handles listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting itinerary items, with authorization checks to ensure operations are performed by the owner of the associated trip.

methods.name: None _assert_trip_owned(db: AsyncSession, trip_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Checks if the specified trip belongs to the current user; raises 404 if not.

methods.name: None _assert_destination_in_trip(db: AsyncSession, destination_id: int, trip_id: int)
methods.description: Verifies if a destination belongs to a trip; raises 422 if not.

methods.name: list[ItineraryItemOut] list_itinerary_items( trip_id: int | None = None, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Lists itinerary items for the current user, possibly filtered by trip_id.

methods.name: ItineraryItemOut create_itinerary_item( payload: ItineraryItemCreate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Creates a new itinerary item after ownership and validation checks.

methods.name: ItineraryItemOut get_itinerary_item( item_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific itinerary item ensuring it belongs to the current user.

methods.name: ItineraryItemOut update_itinerary_item( item_id: int, payload: ItineraryItemUpdate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Updates an existing itinerary item with validation and ownership checks.

methods.name: DeleteResponse delete_itinerary_item( item_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Deletes an itinerary item, ensuring it belongs to the current user.
